title-group.article-title: A synthetic article for parser tests

abstract.p: This abstract summarises a study of tumour microenvironments using multiplexed imaging.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Tumour atlases require harmonised assays across centres [1].

sec.title: Results
sec.p: We identified twelve cell states across three tissue compartments.

sec.title: STAR Methods
sec.p: Tissues were imaged with CODEX on an Akoya PhenoCycler-Fusion instrument.

sec.title: Cell segmentation
sec.p: Cells were segmented with Mesmer version 0.4.

sec.title: Data and code availability
sec.p: Imaging data are deposited in Synapse under accession syn26644864. Analysis code is available at https://github.com/example/atlas-pipeline.

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: Shared vocabularies make cross-centre comparison possible.
